title: Cloud Code automates brand campaigns #cloudcode #aicampaigns #brandads
description:
Cloud Code builds full brand campaigns in 30 minutes by turning a brand URL into structured brand DNA, then using that data to generate visuals, model-led content, and ad creative.

The workflow centers on speed and consistency: product imagery is aligned to the brand, AI-generated models are matched to the target audience, and campaign assets are produced from the same core identity system. That creates a fast, repeatable pipeline for creative production without starting from scratch.

Phygital positions the process as a practical AI marketing system for brands that need rapid campaign development, scalable content output, and tighter alignment between strategy, creative direction, and advertising execution.
